summary: Woman separated from her group and lost hiking up Silver Couloir on Buffalo Mountain; exhausted navigating snow, drenched and near hypothermic; three Summit County Rescue Group teams of three reached her about 7 p.m. near the bottom of the east face and escorted her off the mountain.
notes: SnowBrains article published 2019-07-29, reporting Summit Daily coverage; events 'Friday' = 2019-07-26 (Friday-verified). Run 1018 chunk B.
